request.purpose: Summarize all SQL2 tables whose metadata shows no update since 2026-09-13, separating empty tables
request.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN TABLE_ROWS=0 THEN 'EMPTY' ELSE 'WITH_DATA' END category,COUNT(*) table_count,ROUND(SUM(DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) total_mb,GROUP_CONCAT(TABLE_NAME ORDER BY (DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH) DESC SEPARATOR ' | ') tables_list FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND COALESCE(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) < '2026-09-13 00:00:00' GROUP BY category
